run_kolors_text_to_image: run the KolorsPipeline to generate images from text prompts with optional guidance scale and resolution
encode_kolors_prompt: encode text prompts into ChatGLM hidden state embeddings with pooled embeddings for classifier-free guidance
prepare_kolors_latents: prepare noisy latent tensors scaled by the scheduler init noise sigma for diffusion denoising
prepare_ip_adapter_image_embeds: prepare IP-Adapter image embeddings from reference images for image-conditioned text-to-image generation
retrieve_kolors_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from num_inference_steps or custom timesteps or sigmas for diffusion scheduling
